original.target_description: Study 1: combined looking, approaching and contact person-oriented point-sample scores across crying, humming and talking; within-dog repeated-measures ANOVA main effect of condition.

n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this behavioral analysis; 18 dogs participated and the reported repeated-measures degrees of freedom are consistent with the full sample.
n.location: Article p. 3, Method—Participants; p. 6, Results (PDF pp. 4 and 7 including cover)
n.quote: Eighteen medium-sized domestic dogs (Canis familiaris) from the North West USA participated in the study.

es.location: Article p. 6, Results, paragraph describing Figure 2 (PDF p. 7 including cover)

p.location: Article p. 6, Results, same repeated-measures ANOVA (PDF p. 7 including cover)

replication.target_description: Full replication paper could not be acquired through permitted open-access routes; requested p. 4 behavioral test was not inspected.

notes: Original target is the omnibus condition main effect, rather than a post-hoc comparison or the crying-person versus silent-witness test. Original PDF includes an extra ResearchGate cover; article p. 6 is PDF p. 7. The text extraction renders the printed less-than glyph as a backslash; statistical quotes normalize that glyph. Full replication paper unavailable: DOI landing and PsycNet PDF returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex reported no open copy; Europe PMC reported no full text; primary OSF project zadty contains only a .sav data file and has no child projects; preprint/open-access searches found no full manuscript. ResearchGate exposes only first-page publisher preview; this was not treated as the full paper or used for statistical extraction. Replication statistics and authors narrative verdict left unverified.
